tagline: Fix Linux and Kubernetes in plain language
summary: Manage SSH sessions and Kubernetes clusters in one window. AI Linux Engineer works on the connected host; AI K8S Engineer works on the selected cluster (sidebar Hosts ↔ K8s). You describe the problem; the agent proposes actions. Reads run automatically; mutations need your approval.
feature.aiEngineer.title: AI Linux & K8S Engineers
feature.aiEngineer.desc: Hosts view: tell the connected host “disk is full” or “nginx 502” over your real SSH session. K8s view: troubleshoot CrashLoop, image pulls, and Services with k8s_* tools. Risky changes ask for approval.
feature.k8s.title: Kubernetes workbench
feature.k8s.desc: Switch the sidebar to K8s, then use + to add a cluster (import or paste kubeconfig) or bind an SSH kubectl host. Browse workloads and YAML. Requires kubectl on PATH or on the jump host — not bundled. Not a full Lens clone (no Helm/CRD browser in this release).
feature.policySafe.title: Policy & safety
feature.policySafe.desc: The harness classifies commands by capability (R0–R4): auto-allow reads, approve mutations, deny catastrophes. Unknown scripts are strict. The model cannot bypass policy. API keys stay on-device; execution uses only your open sessions.
feature.dragUpload.title: Drag & drop upload
feature.dragUpload.desc: Drop files onto an SSH terminal or tab to upload via SFTP into the current remote directory.
feature.clickBrowse.title: Click to browse & preview
feature.clickBrowse.desc: Click directories from ls to enter them; click files to open in the preview panel (text, Markdown, CSV, images, PDF) with full-text search for text.
feature.contextTransfer.title: Download & cross-server send
feature.contextTransfer.desc: Right-click files or folders from ls to download or send to another SSH host; or use Ctrl/Cmd+click / drag onto a target tab.
feature.tabShortcuts.title: Tab directory shortcuts
feature.tabShortcuts.desc: Use ~ on a tab to go home; colored folders cd to favorite paths. Right-click to edit; delete asks for confirmation.
feature.bookmarksTransfer.title: Bookmarks & transfers
feature.bookmarksTransfer.desc: Save SSH connections with OS icons; the transfer panel shows progress and per-task cancel.
feature.hostStats.title: Server resources
feature.hostStats.desc: While an SSH tab is active, a bottom status bar shows CPU, memory, load, network, disk, and process count live; hover for full details.
feature.find.title: Find files
feature.find.desc: Run find on the active SSH session from the side rail. Click results to enter or preview.
feature.taskManager.title: Task Manager
feature.taskManager.desc: View processes, ports, memory, and CPU for the active SSH host. Search, sort, and end processes after confirm.
feature.commandNav.title: Command guide
feature.commandNav.desc: Browse ops commands by service, logs, disk, network, and more. Fill parameters and insert into the terminal (does not auto-run).
step.ssh.text: Connect to a Linux host; save it as a bookmark for next time. Or switch the sidebar to K8s and pick a cluster.
step.bookmark.text: Open AI Engineer from the title bar. On Hosts it is Linux mode; on K8s it is K8S mode—approve mutations when prompted.
